label: Bible Study
prompt: A good _____ is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verse: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
note: Reputation over riches — a good name can't be bought, only built.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with _____.
verse: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
note: Miriam grabs a timbrel and leads all the women out dancing on the far side of the sea.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is _____ in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verse: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
note: 'There is death in the pot!' — the prophets' stew was rescued when Elisha tossed in some meal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: As an eagle stirreth up her _____, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verse: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
note: From Moses' final song: the eagle stirs the nest to make the young fly, then catches them on her wings.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing _____, gravity, sincerity,
verse: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
note: Titus' teaching checklist: 'uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity' — integrity nobody can bribe.
